row: The College of Health Care Professions

The College of Health Care Professions is an accredited, Texas-based career college offering innovative on-campus and  online healthcare programs grounded in real-world training for allied healthcare roles. We offer diverse allied healthcare certifications and healthcare degrees at our 9 campus locations and online.

Our mission is simple: build a stronger community by inspiring our students to choose hope for their future, practice compassion in their service, and strive for purpose in their careers. Explore our selection of on-campus and online healthcare degrees and certificates to find the path that’s right for you.
